translation: 웨스트브룩 공공 도서관이 이번 주말 연례 도서 판매 행사에 여러분을 초대합니다. 소설, 요리책, 어린이 책 수천 권을 한 권에 1달러부터 구입할 수 있습니다. 판매는 토요일과 일요일 오전 9시부터 오후 4시까지 진행됩니다. 다음에 가장 좋아할 책을 찾아보시는 건 어떨까요?
tips: one dollar 의 one 을 강조해 싼 가격을 드러낸다
Why not ...? 은 끝을 내린다 ↘

text: Greenfield University announced this morning that it has received a gift of fifteen million dollars from local businesswoman Nancy Chen. The money will be used for scholarships, research equipment, and a new science building. University president Robert Hayes called the gift a wonderful opportunity for students across the state.
marked: *Greenfield* University announced this morning / that it has received a gift of *fifteen* million dollars / from local businesswoman Nancy *Chen*. / The money will be used for *scholarships*, / research equipment, / and a new *science* building. / University president Robert Hayes called the gift / a *wonderful* opportunity / for students across the *state*.
translation: 그린필드 대학교는 오늘 아침 지역 사업가 낸시 첸으로부터 1,500만 달러를 기부받았다고 발표했습니다. 이 돈은 장학금, 연구 장비, 새 과학관 건립에 쓰입니다. 로버트 헤이스 총장은 이 기부가 주 전역의 학생들에게 훌륭한 기회라고 말했습니다.
tips: fifteen 은 뒤 음절 강세, fifty 와 구분
인물 이름 앞에서 살짝 쉬고 이름은 또렷하게

text: You have reached the Grand Plaza Hotel, and if you know your party's extension, please dial it now. For room reservations, press one. For information about our restaurant, fitness center, or spa, press two. Would you like to speak with the front desk? Please press zero or stay on the line.

tips: Would you like ...? 는 끝을 올린다 ↗
zero 의 z 는 성대를 울려 [지로우]

text: On tonight's program, we are pleased to welcome chef Maria Lopez, owner of the popular restaurant Olive Tree. Chef Lopez has worked in Italy, France, and Spain, and she has been cooking professionally for over twenty years. Tonight, she'll show us how to make a simple pasta dinner in just thirty minutes.

text: Good morning, Chicago. It's a cool and cloudy start to the day, with temperatures around fifty degrees. Light rain will begin by noon and continue into the evening. Don't forget your umbrella, raincoat, and warm jacket. The weekend looks much brighter, with sunny skies and highs near sixty-five.
